'''Sector Epsilon 51-3''' was a [[sector]] in [[First Order]] territory, which they kept off-limits to others. During the [[Occupation of the Colossus|occupation]] of [[Castilon]]'s ''[[Colossus]]'' platform, [[Commander]] [[Pyre]] led [[First Order stormtrooper|stormtroopers]] to arrest [[Team Fireball|Team ''Fireball'']] after receiving a report that the team's namesake, the ''[[Fireball]]'', had been seen participating in a [[Resistance]] [[Mission to the Dassal system|mission]] into the sector<ref name="Descent" /> that found clues hinting at the existence of [[Starkiller Base]].<ref name="TROS VD">''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>
